articles.summary: IRVING, Texas, Oct. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ — CMC (NYSE: CMC), today announced that it has been CertifiedTM as a Great Place to Work ® in the United States, Poland and China. Great Place To Work® is a global organization that evaluates workplace culture, employee experience and leadership behaviors through employee surveys – specifically, how consistently employees experience a high-trust workplace. According to the survey, 82% of CMC employees said the company is a Great Place To Work® compared to 57% of employees at a typical U.S.-based company. “CMC’s success is driven by our people, and this recognition is especially meaningful because it reflects their feedback,” said Peter Matt, President and Chief Executive Officer of CMC. “Our employees play an important role in creating the culture we have across CMC. This certification reflects our team’s commitment to one another, our customers and the work we do every day.” CMC employs more than 13,000 people worldwide. For more than 110 years, generations of employees have helped shape the company’s growth and success, and their dedication, experience and contributions continue to be an important part of CMC today.
